---
title: "Talk with Reachy"
---

Talk with Reachy is research software for a Reachy Mini robot. It is used in a study at the University of Cincinnati led by Renkai Ma, and it is not offered to the public.

The software lets the robot hold spoken conversations and records them for the study. When a study team member signs in with a Google account, the robot saves its study files to a "Talk with Reachy" folder in that account's Google Drive.
